title.en: Getting started with your learning platform

en.d: When you sign in you land on My Learning — your courses, new content and CPD progress, all in one place.
Your Season CPD Points live at the top right, with your target and how many are left to go. Completing units earns points — reach the target and you're all set for the season.
Scroll down for rows of content: session plans by age group, masterclasses, webinars — and your assigned modules with their progress.
Click a module card to open it. The "In progress" and "Completed" tabs show where you left off.
Each module shows its progress bar and is split into units. The icons on each unit show how many questions it has and the CPD time it earns.
Click a unit to begin. Completed units are marked with a green tick.
Inside a unit, each lesson is a short video followed by a quick question. Watch the video, then click continue to answer.
The Unit Overview lists every lesson and question, ticking them off as you go — so you always know exactly where you are.
Click the magnifying glass and type a topic, coach or module name — then press Enter.
The search page shows everything that matches, and you can narrow it down by type or category.
Or open "Categories" in the top menu to jump straight to a topic — from tactical themes to age groups.

en.doneD: You know your way around: find content, work through units lesson by lesson, and watch your CPD points grow. Your progress is saved automatically — pick up any time, right where you left off.
en.lead: For coaches. Your first tour of the platform: where everything lives and how to start earning CPD points.
